x: In Quinlan's heat the runners ran in a bunch for three-quarters of the distance; John was fairly well boxed in, and in the final dash was fourth.

Quinlan set a rare pace in the 880 Yards only to be beaten down the straight, and he should improve with better racing tactics. Boddy ran well to finish second in the 1 Mile, while De Knop, the Middlesex Junior champion, won the 440 Yards and Long Jump.
